description: This file contains build definitions, macros, and device-specific configurations for the OpenWrt project targeting iMX Cortex-A9 boards. It defines build procedures, device profiles, and instructions for creating boot images, filesystems, and flashing scripts.

methods.name: Build/boot-overlay
methods.description: Creates a boot overlay directory, copies kernel images, device trees, and creates a boot script and ubifs image.

methods.name: Build/bootfs.tar.gz
methods.description: Packages boot files into a tarball, extracting a base tar and creating a gzipped archive.

methods.name: Build/recovery-scr
methods.description: Generates a recovery bootscript image using mkimage.

methods.name: Build/apalis-emmc
methods.description: Prepares and creates a combined image for the Apalis device, including cleaning temporary artifacts.

methods.name: Build/ventana-img
methods.description: Builds a bootable image for the Ventana device, including kernel, device trees, custom boot scripts, and final image packaging.
